issues.t: Front brake caliper leaking fluid
issues.sym: Brake fluid on the inside of a front wheel, a low brake fluid warning, or a pedal that feels softer than normal.
issues.why: Brakes are the most-reported problem area for the 2023 CX-50 in NHTSA complaints, and the top CarComplaints entry is a front brake fluid leak at around 47,000 miles.
issues.next: A brake fluid leak is a safety issue. Check the fluid level and have the brakes inspected before driving far; if the pedal sinks, have the car towed.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking activates for no reason
issues.sym: The car brakes hard or flashes a collision warning when nothing is in the way.
issues.why: Owners have filed several NHTSA complaints about false warnings and automatic braking, and Mazda issued bulletins SA-077-23 and SA-007-24a for unintended Smart Brake Support activation.
issues.next: Note when and where it happens and tell the dealer the bulletin numbers. Keep the windshield and front sensors clean, and stay alert to traffic behind you.

issues.t: Brake noise, judder or dragging
issues.sym: Squealing or grinding from the brakes, a shake through the pedal or wheel when stopping, or a brake that feels like it drags.
issues.why: Mazda put out bulletins SA-003-23a and SA-016-24 to help dealers diagnose brake noise, judder and dragging on this model.
issues.next: Have the pads, rotors and caliper slides inspected and ask the dealer to follow the bulletin.

issues.t: ABS control unit may be damaged (recall)
issues.sym: The ABS or brake warning light comes on, and stopping distances can get longer.
issues.why: The hydraulic control unit for the anti-lock brakes on some early cars may be damaged.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard, press it much harder than normal. If it sinks, feels soft or goes closer to the floor, or a red brake warning comes on, slow down gently, use a lower gear, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on: call for a tow. Check the VIN for recall 23V-275. The dealer inspects the unit and replaces it if needed.

issues.t: Front camera fault disables emergency braking (recall)
issues.sym: Driver-assist warning messages; automatic emergency braking, lane-keep assist or automatic high beams may stop working.
issues.why: The forward sensing camera on some cars can malfunction.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 24V-649. The dealer inspects and replaces the camera for free.

issues.t: Electronic parking brake stuck in maintenance mode
issues.sym: The electronic parking brake will not apply or release normally and a warning stays on.
issues.why: The parking brake can stay in the service mode used for brake jobs. Mazda covered this in bulletins SA-055-22, 04-003-23 and SA-011-23.
issues.next: Have the dealer or a shop with a Mazda-capable scan tool take the brake out of maintenance mode.

issues.t: Front suspension bolts may not be tight (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or knocking from the front, vibration, or steering that wanders.
issues.why: Some front suspension bolts were not tightened properly at the factory. In the worst case a suspension part or wheel could come loose.
issues.next: If you hear new clunks from the front, stop driving and call the dealer. Check the VIN for recall 25V-737.

issues.t: Steering shimmy from flat-spotted tires
issues.sym: A shimmy in the steering wheel or a body shake at highway speed, often on a car that sat before delivery.
issues.why: Tires on cars that sit for a while can develop flat spots. Mazda bulletins SA-008-23 and SA-013-24 address this.
issues.next: Drive the car normally for a few days; flat spots often go away. If not, have the tires and balance checked.

issues.t: Growl or whine from a wheel bearing
issues.sym: A growl or whine that rises with speed and may change when turning.
issues.why: Mazda bulletin SA-006-22 notes that a noise blamed on the differential, transfer case or transmission was actually a wheel bearing.
issues.next: Ask the shop to check the wheel bearings before replacing drivetrain parts.

issues.t: Check engine light and low power after a cold start
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P061B or a misfire, and the engine feels weak at full throttle after a cold start.
issues.why: Mazda bulletins 01-014-22, 01-015-22 and 01-011-23 fix this with new engine computer software, including a case at high elevation.
issues.next: Have the code read and ask the dealer about the software update.

issues.t: Check engine light for a lean condition
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P0171, sometimes with misfire codes.
issues.why: Mazda bulletin MT-004-22 covers this lean fault code on the CX-50.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer about the bulletin.

issues.t: Tapping or rattle from the valve train
issues.sym: A light tapping or rattling from the top of the engine.
issues.why: Mazda issued bulletins SA-023-22, SA-026-23 and SA-024-24 to help diagnose valve train noise.
issues.next: Let the dealer listen to it while under warranty and keep the oil at the right level.

issues.t: Cylinder deactivation fault
issues.sym: A check engine light or rough running, related to the system that shuts off two cylinders at light load.
issues.why: An owner of a 2025 CX-50 reported a cylinder deactivation solenoid problem at about 1,000 miles. Cylinder deactivation is used on the non-turbo 2.5L engine.
issues.next: Have the codes read promptly and keep the car under warranty for the repair.

issues.t: Oil seepage at the drive belt tensioner
issues.sym: An oily film or seepage around the drive belt tensioner at the front of the engine.
issues.why: A 2025 CX-50 owner reported oil seepage at the factory belt tensioner at around 29,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the leak source confirmed; check the oil level between changes until it is repaired.

issues.t: Jolt when pulling away at low speed
issues.sym: A shock or jerk from the transmission when starting off from a stop.
issues.why: Mazda bulletin 05-001-23 traces this to the torque converter lock-up timing in the transmission computer software.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for the transmission software update.

issues.t: Hybrid shifter can leave Neutral without the brake (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter can be moved from Neutral into Drive without pressing the brake pedal.
issues.why: A software or control unit fault on a small number of hybrids lets the shift interlock fail.
issues.next: Always hold the brake when shifting. Check the VIN for recall 25V-418; the dealer replaces the engine computer and reprograms the hybrid controls.

issues.t: Airbag control software set up wrong (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom; the airbag light may come on.
issues.why: The airbag control module software on some CX-50 and CX-50 Hybrid models was configured incorrectly, so airbags may not deploy the right way.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 25V-413. The dealer updates the software for free.

issues.t: Hybrid battery label has the wrong QR code (emissions recall)
issues.sym: Nothing you notice while driving. The traction battery labels have QR codes that do not link to the required battery information.
issues.why: Some 2026 CX-50 Hybrids built in September 2025 got the wrong labels, which breaks a California battery labeling rule. Mazda campaign 8026C replaces them.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the VIN for campaign 8026C at your next visit.

issues.t: Coolant reservoir cap can blow off
issues.sym: Coolant spraying or steam from under the hood, a coolant smell, or the temperature gauge rising.
issues.why: An owner reported the coolant cap failing on a nearly new 2024 CX-50.
issues.next: If you see steam or the gauge climbs, pull over and let the engine cool before opening anything. Have the cap and cooling system pressure-tested.

issues.t: Weak A/C from a leaking condenser
issues.sym: The air conditioning blows cool but not cold, and i-Stop engine shutoff works less often.
issues.why: Mazda bulletin SA-048-22 links poor A/C and i-Stop behavior to a leaking A/C condenser.
issues.next: Have the A/C pressures and condenser checked for leaks under warranty.

issues.t: Musty smell or water from a wet cabin air filter
issues.sym: A musty smell from the vents or water dripping near the cabin air filter.
issues.why: Mazda bulletin SA-012-23 covers water getting into the HVAC and soaking the cabin air filter.
issues.next: Replace the cabin filter and ask the dealer to check the drain and seals per the bulletin.

issues.t: "In-Vehicle Network Malfunction" warning
issues.sym: A dashboard or screen message saying In-Vehicle Network Malfunction or Telematics fault, with code U3000.
issues.why: Mazda put out a long series of bulletins (09-001-23 and later revisions) for this message, mostly fixed with software.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for the latest bulletin software update.

issues.t: Fuel door stuck closed
issues.sym: The fuel filler door will not open at the pump.
issues.why: Mazda bulletins SA-059-22 and SA-020-23 address fuel doors that stick shut.
issues.next: Have the dealer adjust or replace the fuel door parts under warranty.

issues.t: Rattle from the panoramic sunroof
issues.sym: A rattle or buzz from the roof area, especially on rough roads.
issues.why: Mazda has issued a string of sunroof rattle bulletins (SA-032-22a through SA-001-24a), and owners report it too.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to apply the latest sunroof rattle bulletin.

issues.t: Wind noise from the roof crossbars
issues.sym: Whistling or wind noise at highway speed, or the sunroof hits the crossbars when opening.
issues.why: Mazda bulletin SA-029-22a covers wind noise from the roof crossbars and crossbars that block the sunroof.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to adjust the crossbars per the bulletin, and keep roof loads clear of the sunroof path.

issues.t: Dashboard rattle on the passenger side
issues.sym: A rattle from the right side of the dash that can get louder over time.
issues.why: Mazda bulletin SA-026-24 covers a rattle traced as far as the passenger airbag area, and owners describe dash rattles that dealers struggled to fix.
issues.next: Have the dealer track it down under warranty and mention the bulletin.

issues.t: Paint peeling on the front bumper
issues.sym: Paint flaking or peeling off the front bumper cover.
issues.why: Mazda bulletin SA-047-22 covers front bumper paint peeling, and owners report dealers declining to cover it later.
issues.next: Report it as early as possible while under warranty and take photos.

issues.t: Windshield cracks with little or no impact
issues.sym: A crack spreads across the windshield without a clear rock hit.
issues.why: Owners of the 2024 CX-50 report stress cracks or defects in the windshield at very low mileage.
issues.next: Contact the dealer right away if it happens on a new car. After replacement, the front camera must be recalibrated.

issues.t: Cloth seats fray early
issues.sym: Fraying or pilling of the cloth seat fabric after a few thousand miles.
issues.why: Owners of the 2024 CX-50 report that the fabric seat covers wear quickly.
issues.next: Show the dealer early and ask for a warranty or goodwill seat cover replacement.

issues.t: Trailer hitch wiring may come loose (recall)
issues.sym: Trailer lights or trailer brakes stop working.
issues.why: On cars with Mazda's accessory trailer hitch, the hitch wiring harness can detach and get damaged.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 23V-135 before towing.
issues.sevReason: Trailer light wiring can come loose; not a structural hitch failure.

issues.t: Trailer hitch bolts can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: A rattle or movement from the hitch, or trailer lights that stop working.
issues.why: Bolts holding Mazda's accessory trailer hitch can loosen, so the hitch could separate from the car.
issues.next: Do not tow until it is checked. Look up the VIN for recall 25V-167.

issues.t: Rear door window comes loose from its holder
issues.sym: A rattle inside a rear door, and the rear window may not roll down.
issues.why: On some 2026 CX-50s built in late May 2026, the adhesive between the rear door glass and its holder did not bond properly. Mazda bulletin DRW 60 replaces both rear door glasses.
issues.next: If a rear window rattles or will not move, ask the dealer whether your VIN is in DRW 60.

issues.t: Door beltline molding loose or missing
issues.sym: The trim strip along the bottom of a side window is loose, flaps, or falls off.
issues.why: Mazda bulletin SA-004-26 covers door beltline moldings that come loose or go missing on 2026 models.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to replace or reattach the molding under warranty.

issues.t: No audio or radio from the infotainment
issues.sym: No sound, static, or the audio source cannot be changed.
issues.why: Mazda bulletins 09-039-23 (remote tuner) and SA-058-22 (codes U2145 and U0186) cover audio dropouts on the CX-50.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the bulletins; a software update or a new remote tuner usually fixes it.

issues.t: Wireless phone charger does not charge
issues.sym: The wireless (Qi) charging pad will not charge the phone.
issues.why: Mazda released several bulletins (SA-021-23 series and 09-023-23b) for this.
issues.next: Try removing the phone case first, then ask the dealer about the bulletin.
